nodes.name: Setup CI/CD Infrastructure for E2E Testing
nodes.description: Configure GitHub Actions workflows, Docker containers, and test environment setup for automated E2E pipeline execution

nodes.name: Develop Test Orchestration Layer
nodes.description: Create automated test orchestration system that can manage E2E test execution, parallel test runs, and result aggregation

nodes.name: Implement Dynamic Environment Management
nodes.description: Build system for creating, configuring, and tearing down isolated test environments for each CI run

nodes.name: Create Test Data Pipeline
nodes.description: Develop automated test data generation, seeding, and cleanup mechanisms for consistent E2E test execution

nodes.name: Build E2E Test Monitoring System
nodes.description: Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting for E2E test execution in CI/CD pipeline

nodes.name: Integration with Feature Factory E2E Tests
nodes.description: Integrate existing E2E tests (orchestrator, health checks, full pipeline) into CI automation framework

nodes.name: QA Test Infrastructure Validation
nodes.description: Validate CI/CD infrastructure setup, test environment provisioning, and automated test execution reliability

nodes.name: QA Test Orchestration Validation
nodes.description: Test the orchestration layer for proper test scheduling, parallel execution, failure handling, and result aggregation

nodes.name: QA Environment Management Testing
nodes.description: Validate dynamic environment creation, configuration consistency, and proper cleanup procedures

nodes.name: QA Test Data Pipeline Validation
nodes.description: Test data seeding reliability, fixture consistency, and cleanup completeness across different test scenarios

nodes.name: QA Monitoring System Validation
nodes.description: Validate monitoring accuracy, alerting mechanisms, and performance metrics collection during E2E test execution

nodes.name: QA Feature Factory Integration Testing
nodes.description: Comprehensive testing of Feature Factory E2E integration with CI pipeline, including orchestrator workflows and health checks

nodes.name: QA CI/CD Performance Testing
nodes.description: Performance testing of E2E CI pipeline including execution time optimization, resource usage, and scalability validation

nodes.name: Security Testing for CI/CD E2E Pipeline
nodes.description: Security validation of CI/CD pipeline including secrets management, network security, and access controls

nodes.name: Generate E2E CI/CD Documentation
nodes.description: Create comprehensive documentation for E2E CI/CD pipeline including setup guides, troubleshooting, and maintenance procedures

nodes.name: Infrastructure Setup Gate Review
nodes.description: Gate review to ensure CI/CD infrastructure meets requirements before proceeding with testing phases

nodes.name: Integration Testing Gate Review
nodes.description: Gate review to validate all integration testing is complete and successful before final deployment

nodes.name: Deploy E2E CI/CD Pipeline
nodes.description: Final deployment of E2E CI/CD pipeline with all components, monitoring, and documentation in place

All QA validation phases completed successfully with documented test results
